_about: Data for ND Pose Builder (same engine as the Character Builder, see character_builder.json for the shared fields). Generated by tools/make_pose_data.py from tools/pose_tables.py and tools/pose_presets.py; edit this file directly to tune wording. Option fields: text (the words in the Create text; a participle after 'She is', or a full sentence for arms.both and fluids), tag (Danbooru), edit (an instruction for Edit mode), explicit (needs the Explicit switch), anatomy (the body parts the character must all have: vulva, penis, testicles, breasts, anus), anatomy_any (at least one of them), postures (the body postures random may pair the option with), mutes (parameters the option switches off, e.g. 'arms.hand1'), group (a heading in the list), area (what the hand reaches: names of 'covers', used to tell whether it is dressed), both_hands (the act uses both hands), solo (the sentence when nothing else is set), noun (a toy's name in {toy}), levels / default_level (how a toy is used or how much of a fluid: each level has text, edit, tag, anatomy). Pose presets (parameter pose.preset, macro): sets (values of other parameters, as ids; a list for a multi parameter), core (the parameters that make the pose 'modified' when changed), lead (a phrase added to the posture sentence while the pose is unchanged), cat (category zone), icon (a posture id), sets_levels (levels of toys / fluids). Subject options: pron and have (anatomy). Zones: level (simple / advanced / both), explicit, params ('pose.preset@cat' shows only the poses of a category).
